purpose: Original TFS V3 H duplicate-gather versus AMX C tile staging, with per-step and window 8/16/32/64 methods
cpu: 32 physical cores, one socket, CPU IDs 32-63
timing_boundary: Prepared two-layer BF16-input TFS, including L1, ReLU, interlayer FP32-to-BF16 conversion and L2; initial H conversion and W packing excluded
repeats: 5 per graph-method in each of two independent graph-order runs
correctness: 56 real-graph method checks pass bitwise at L1 FP32, interlayer BF16 and final L2 BF16; cross-run artifact audit PASS
result: Fixed window 64 versus original TFS: four-graph geometric mean speedup 1.220x first order, 1.219x reverse order; per graph 1.117-1.320x across runs. Naive per-step A1 regresses on Reddit/Products.
limitations: Shared node; logical access counts are not DRAM bytes; no PMU counters; no isolated phase wall-time for H gather/C state/AMX; exact W32-vs-W64 ranking unresolved on two graphs
next: Collect sampled phase and PMU evidence, then repeat on exclusive node before paper claim; keep original TFS and D16 matched-gather control
